remarks: GIVEN THIS IS A HOLIDAY WEEKEND THE TRUSTEES FOR THIS PROPERTY HAVE REQUESTED OFFERS BE SUBMITTED VIA EMAIL TO THE LISTING BROKERS BY NOON WEDNESDAY APRIL 23RD. Located on one of Darien's most sought-after cul-de-sacs this Cape Cod Colonial on 1.14 acres and an East / West orientation is available for the first time in over 70 years. This property is perfect for those looking to bring their vision to create a dream home by expanding and renovating the existing house or as new build. Pasture Lane provides a picturesque country setting in a coastal community area with convenience to Weed Beach, the YMCA, Hindley School, RR & transportation access including the numerous amenities within Darien. A location without compromise so you don't have to. Please see new survey with wetlands boundary line transposed on map. Survey and soil test on file in the EPC / zoning office at Town Hall.
